headline: Leeds 4-1 Newcastle: third in the table, Jaissle's first defeat
whyCareReason: Unbeaten Leeds go third. Miley own goal, Bogle, Calvert-Lewin, Okafor. Touré's 90th-minute reply is the only Newcastle shot that counted.
teaser: FINAL: Leeds 4-1 Newcastle. Miley OG 32', Bogle 34', Calvert-Lewin 45+1', Okafor 59', Touré 90'. Leeds 2-2-0, 8 points.
story:
Why this one matters: both clubs arrived on five points from three games. The rest of matchweek 4 was already in the book. Elland Road finished it 4-1, and Leeds are third.

ESPN: Lewis Miley own goal 32', a double deflection after Ao Tanaka struck from the edge of the box. Jayden Bogle 34', after Calvert-Lewin's header from James Justin's cross clipped him on the way in. Dominic Calvert-Lewin 45+1', side-stepping Sven Botman. Noah Okafor 59' on the half-volley after Ethan Ampadu's long throw. Bazoumana Touré 90' for Newcastle. Nico González went off in the 20th minute; Sean Steur came on.

Sky, AFP and The Athletic print the same 4-1. Leeds 2-2-0, 8 points, plus four. Newcastle 1-2-1, 5 points, 12th. First league defeat for Matthias Jaissle.
stakes: Matchweek 4 is closed. Arsenal 12, City 12, Leeds 8, Hull 8. Newcastle slip on goal difference.
rivalryAngle: Two unbeaten league starts met on a Monday. Only one left Elland Road still unbeaten.
